title: Rot & Ferment
author: w4tak
selftext:
I made an idle game for iOS and Android - where all artwork is made with chat GPT using very specific prompt engineering to get the desired result (my brother is an artist - oil paintings and photography and did all of the art in this game - using the AI) and it was loved by some and absolutely slammed by others.

So the game is an idle game about fermentation and follows the story of our heroine Magda - she starts with a single cellar and a few moneys and you then make more and more "expensive" recipies to unlock more and more recipies and cellars.  
Along the way there are obviously achievements etx which you unlock and these are the art.

I recieved some very positive comments on google play and other saying AI SLOP - 1 star.   
This is very sad and baffling to me as the game itself is genuinely fun.

The game was made using Godot - with Claude Sonnet and Opus doing a lot of the heavy lifting but I also wanted to learn how to use these tools for game dev so I familiarized myself with it.

[Very differing reviews](https://preview.redd.it/hyoaeai938th1.png?width=1678&format=png&auto=webp&s=8319e6116b491059190524a6070c029b64612c1c)

I think the best part about the process using AI was setting up Fastlane to do the screenshots, the localizations in 9 languages, the uploading to testflight and internal testing, it just saves so. much. time when you're iterating often and testing.   
Without AI's help just learning what goes where in the 2 stores would be a full time job.

Anyway, I'm very happy with the game and it's alread made about 50 Eur with over 1000 players.

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.watak.rotandferment](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.watak.rotandferment)  
[https://apps.apple.com/app/rot-ferment/id6800438731](https://apps.apple.com/app/rot-ferment/id6800438731)

Cheers!

replies.author: w4tak
replies.body:
Thank you so much, this means the world to me, I appreciate it. And sorry, that’s a nasty bug: losing your mother culture every time is really terrible. I’m on it right now. It looks like the save isn’t surviving when the phone closes the game in the background (POCO/Xiaomi phones are aggressive about that).   
A fix is coming in the next update. Until then, try going back to the main menu before closing the game, that might help to mitigate the save issue. I’ll reply here when the fix is out - but it should be later tonight.
